_comment: Web 牛奶冰沙视觉配置。共用 Web_MilkSlush_SharedCup 杯体；slush=冰沙液面、glass=杯身、straw=吸管；garnish=杯口装饰。风格提示词供 icon/贴图 AI 或手绘参考。
_styleBaseZh: 胡闹厨房 Overcooked 风格卡通饮品、玻璃杯、绵密牛奶冰沙质感、顶部真实水果装饰、柔和 PBR、无描边、干净背景、45° 产品展示
_styleBaseEn: Overcooked-style cartoon drink, clear glass cup, creamy milk slush texture, fresh fruit garnish on rim, soft PBR, no outline, clean background, 45-degree product shot
